text:
Maya: Quick thread to finalize the "Observability Heatmap" checklist for GA. We need: 1) exact metrics we surface per-customer, 2) alert thresholds for SLO paging, 3) how credits are calculated for partial/regional failures, and 4) any product limits we call out. Short answers please.
Priya: Docs owner: I'll make a 1-pager and a small customer-facing heatmap graphic. Need firm list of metrics first (95th, 99th, error%). Also confirm whether we show per-route breakdown for Private installs.
Aj: Eng: metrics we can realistically ship by GA: per-route 95th latency, requests/sec, and error rate. 99th is expensive at scale but ok for Gold only (dedicated). For Private we need a feature flag - default off.
Lina: SRE: alert proposals: page if route 95th > target for 6m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 10m. For Gold (dedicated) also page on 99th > target for 3m. We'll include synthetic canary checks per-region every 5m. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/sre/ga-obs-runbook
Keisha: Product: I want the customer heatmap to show green/yellow/red per-region + per-route. For Bronze customers show only global aggregate. Silver shows per-region aggregate. Gold shows per-route. That matches our SLA tiers.
Priya: Good. I'll author the heatmap with those levels. Also adding a small "What this means" note explaining why 99th is Gold-only.
Maya: Credits: we need a simple, conservative formula. Billing?
billing-bot: Billing note: proposed credit = min(50%, (affected_token_seconds / total_token_seconds_in_period)) * monthly_recurring_charge. For partial/regional failures we calculate affected_token_seconds by filtering telemetry tags + canary logs. Customers must file claim within 30 days.
Aj: Implementation detail: when fallback_to_variant triggers we'll tag requests fallback=true. That allows billing/analytics to exclude those. Also we'll tag region and route in telemetry.
Lina: Important operational nuance: if customer disables route-level telemetry (Private opt-out) we will fall back to synthetic canaries + customer-provided logs for impact assessment. Add that to runbook.
Priya: For the customer-facing doc, can we show an example credit calculation (numbers)? That helps reduce disputes.
billing-bot: We'll provide an example in the SLA doc. Finance asks to include rounding rules and the 50% cap.
Maya: Alerts: Aj/Lina, can you paste a canonical PromQL alert for the 95th page? Priya needs it for docs.
Lina: Paste below (PromQL-ish):
```
alert: route_slo_page
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, region)) > ROUTE_THRESHOLD
for: 6m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Also error rate alert:
```
alert: route_error_page
expr: sum(rate(request_errors_total[5m])) by (route, region) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route, region) > 0.005
for: 10m
```
Maya: Nice. Priya, include these snippets. Aj, confirm feature flag name for Private telemetry so docs match code.
Aj: Flag = "route_metrics". Default off for Private. We'll add an admin toggle in Console and export a screenshot. PR in 48h.
Keisha: UX: add a short modal that explains: "Per-route metrics require additional telemetry; disable for tighter privacy or lower overhead." Priya add copy.
Priya: Will do. I'll also add FAQ: "How do credits get calculated during multi-region incidents?" using billing-bot example.
Lina: One more ops rule: we mute alerts for 10m during deploy windows and add automatic assessment job after incidents to create a verification report (tags: impacted_customers). That helps disputes.
Maya: Action items + ETAs: Aj -> feature flag PR + admin toggle screenshot (48h). Lina -> runbook additions + alert rules + verification job (24h). Priya -> heatmap 1-pager + docs + example credit calc (36h). Billing-bot/Finance -> finalize credit formula rounding and example (24h). Keisha -> UX modal copy (36h). I'll assemble and circulate for sign-off after items land.
deploy-bot: Scheduled pre-GA canary run: 2026-04-06 00:00 UTC for 72h.
Maya: If anyone can't hit ETAs call out now. Otherwise I'll send the consolidated sign-off doc tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
